The far-side vane is naturally occluded. Both views must describe the exact same pair of straight aft-facing parts.

Preserve aggressively: all teal cranium plates, the central ivory crown ridge and ochre channel, continuous amber visor, closed ivory faceplate, cheek armor, round temple hubs, graphite neck, collar, shoulders, head proportions, cel shading, ink style, palette, relative view sizes, cameras and framing. This is a tiny antenna direction/shape correction only.
